text:
Hi everyone!
Reaching out here because I don’t know what to do anymore. 

Mid May my partner and I had our Interview at MH Tel Aviv for my first B1 visa. The interview went really well and the clerk said I will get the visa. We did the whole process with a lawyer. The clerk asked our lawyer to send all our documents for the application online and then my partner and I could come the week after to pick up the visa. 

Our lawyer is trying since 3 weeks to upload the documents but it doesn’t work on the website. 

Today I went to MH with my lawyer and after waiting for multiple hours they said they solved the problem in the system and she will be able to upload the documents today, so we can come on Monday to get the visa. After that our lawyer tried again a few times today and it still doesn’t work. Has this happened to anyone here maybe? 

I need to get the visa until the middle of next week because I urgently need to fly to Germany. 

Happy about any advice, thank you
